fields.label: integration.fields.importer_name
fields.description: Use the consignee/importer details explicitly printed on the primary commercial invoice. Keep different counterparties on other documents as separate source evidence; do not silently merge identities or addresses.

fields.label: integration.fields.importer_postcode
fields.description: Use the consignee/importer details explicitly printed on the primary commercial invoice. Keep different counterparties on other documents as separate source evidence; do not silently merge identities or addresses.

fields.label: integration.fields.importer_address
fields.description: Use the consignee/importer details explicitly printed on the primary commercial invoice. Keep different counterparties on other documents as separate source evidence; do not silently merge identities or addresses.

fields.label: integration.fields.invoice_currency
fields.description: Extract only the printed invoice currency code. Delivery terms such as FOB are a separate field.

fields.label: integration.fields.declaration_office
fields.description: Extract the complete printed customs office or unit name, never its office code or an invented personal name. This form repeats that reviewed office name in its header and row 70 by an explicit form-filling convention.

fields.label: integration.fields.invoice_incoterm
fields.description: Extract the explicitly printed Incoterm code, such as FOB, from the primary invoice. Quote only the printed code; exclude the named port, currency and amount. Do not infer a term from transport charges.

fields.label: integration.fields.quantity_secondary
fields.description: For this form, secondary quantity is the explicitly printed NET weight of this goods line, excluding packaging. Use the primary invoice line weight, never gross weight, carton quantity or a whole-shipment total copied to every line. With exactly one goods line, the matching printed total net weight is also valid. Preserve the original numeric quote and weight unit; do not calculate missing weights.

fields.label: integration.fields.quantity_secondary_unit
fields.description: The printed weight unit attached to the net weight used as secondary quantity in this form. Preserve its printed notation, for example KGS; do not substitute boxes or sets.
